new: Chronicle Vol. 1 p.120. Spoken twice in Warcraft III's Forsaken Kingdom campaign (patch 3.0), by the dark ranger Anya ('And for the fall of Quel'Thalas!') and by Ilastar ('Quel'Thalas has fallen, and the Sunwell is gone'). notes: Unglossed. The wiki's by-ear spelling of a Sentinel line in the orc mission The Spirits of Ashenvale (Orc04), which has no subtitle. Two families agree on roughly 'anaduna ?alore isera duna ban?os': Gemini 3.8 Flash heard 'ana duna valore isera duna bandolos' and Scribe v2 'Anaduna farore i sera duna banthros'. Wizper turned it into English ('I'm going to make a flower. And you're going to make a bunch.'), but its 'a flower' also has an f. All three listeners hear f or v where the wiki writes thalore, and a- where it writes anu; machine listeners often confuse f and th, so a person should settle that consonant. The wiki's list of WoW's Darnassian scrambler words has Anoduna and Banthalos, close to this line's first and last words. So a WoW line that uses them may be scrambler output, and banthalos may be Blizzard's own spelling (not confirmed; report 11).

evidence.quote: Anu dunah thalore. Iseradune banthalos (phonetic spelling) - Spoken by Sentinels in Ashenvale spying on the Warsong clan
